title: Simulate two-user interaction scenario
description:
Create a test scenario simulating two users (alice and bob) interacting in real-time:

## Goals
- Verify WebSocket concurrent connections work
- Test delta operations between multiple clients
- Validate operational transformation (OT) for conflict resolution
- Demonstrate real-time collaboration features

## Scenarios to Test
1. Alice creates a new wave, Bob joins
2. Both users add content simultaneously
3. Participant add/remove operations
4. Document edits with potential conflicts
5. Offline/reconnection handling

## Implementation Options
- Two Emacs instances (batch or GUI)
- Python test script with two WebSocket clients
- Playwright/Selenium for E2E browser testing

## Success Criteria
- Both clients see synchronized state
- No data loss on concurrent edits
- Proper attribution of changes to each user

title: Wave protocol for gastown agent communication
description:
Use Wave as the communication substrate for gastown agents (polecats, deacon, mayor, witness, refinery).

## Concept
Each gastown agent becomes a Wave participant:
- mayor@wave - Orchestrates and assigns work
- deacon@wave - Background task processor  
- witness@wave - Observes and logs activity
- refinery@wave - Processes and transforms data
- polecat-{name}@wave - Ephemeral workers

## Benefits
- Real-time collaboration between agents
- Persistent conversation history (wavelets)
- Operational transformation for concurrent edits
- Built-in participant management
- Existing WebSocket infrastructure

## Implementation
1. Each agent connects to Wave server via WebSocket
2. Waves represent work items or conversations
3. Wavelets track specific threads/subtasks
4. Delta operations for state changes
5. Use existing elisp or Python client

## Example Flow
1. Mayor creates wave: "Implement feature X"
2. Adds participants: polecat-furiosa, witness
3. Polecat posts updates as blips
4. Witness records all activity
5. Mayor closes wave when complete

## Integration Points
- gt sling -> creates wave with assignee
- gt stash -> snapshot wave state for handoff
- bd sync -> sync bead state via wave updates
